item.title: Version 0.7
item.description:
You have a cat now

Switch on I have a cat before you start, and a cat turns up for the clean. It's a different cat each time, in a different mood, so it's worth cleaning again just to see who shows up.

  • The Supervisor sits nearby and watches the robot work. It helps about as much as you'd expect.
  • The Loaf falls asleep right in the robot's way. The robot bumps it twice, gives up, and goes around.
  • The Rider climbs on and gets driven around, purring. The robot sounds heavier with it on board, because it is.
  • The Swatter picks a fight. Fur flies. The robot is not ready for this.

You can pick the cat up, too. It will complain. Try dropping it on the robot and see what it does, because they don't all react the same way.

The cat is only for show. It can get in the robot's way, but it never changes what happens to your files. The meows are a real cat called Elix, recorded by Joseph Sardin.

Also new

  • When a clean finishes, the panel shows just the result, so its buttons no longer end up off the bottom of your screen.
  • After your first finished clean, I ask once for a star or a coffee. It's one small card, and you'll never see it again.

Thanks for downloading this silly thing. It's been a lot more fun than I expected.

Raufan
